description: Symbolic χ^λ_q(β_atomic(0, 1)) — neutron — for the canonical atomic braid word at H_3, per partition λ ⊢ 3.  Incrementally saved per partition so a SIGTERM/timeout mid-loop preserves work done so far.
q0AnchorReason: Symbolic in q. chi_lambda_symbolic returns q_character_on_braid_word(shape, crossings, Q) with Q a sympy Symbol, so chi_q_symbolic holds rational functions of a formal q, not values at a substrate anchor. convention and convention_fingerprint derive from the braid word; the remaining fields are partition counts, timings and worker count. No field in this payload is evaluated at q0.
